name: What are the tax implications of selling as-is versus fixing first?

mainEntity.name: What are the tax implications of selling as-is versus fixing first?

acceptedAnswer.text: The tax implications generally depend on your overall profit and how you handle capital gains, rather than specifically on selling as-is versus fixing. However, documented repair costs undertaken before selling can sometimes be added to your home's cost basis, potentially reducing your taxable gain. Consult with a tax professional to understand how repairs or an as-is sale may impact your individual tax situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tax implications depend on profit and capital gains; documented repair costs can sometimes reduce taxable gains. Consult a tax professional.
